Python — Quoted

Intrinsic calibration, intrinsic-parameter writing, and factory-intrinsic restoration are available only on camera models and firmware that provide those APIs. Write operations use a complete CameraParametersConfig.

Correspond calibration.py In it, the internal referencing interface is used to identify the internal referencing panel, manage the map alignment, calculate the camera internal and external referencing, and independently check the current internal cucuracy.

API Reference

identify_board(ip)

Purpose: Triggers the photograph and identifies the type of inner-referenced panel, while returning to the test preview to confirm the plate type and visibility.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

Returns: Board Recognition dict or None.

check_intrinsic_accuracy(ip)

Purpose: Perform an independent internal nuance accuracy check, including filming, tablet estimation, single camera re-projection error and stereo alignment error calculation; no images are added to the marked session.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

Returns: Precision check dict or None.

add_calib_image(ip, board_type)

Purpose: Collect a set of depth sources and colour sources by the identified plate and add the camera ' s current internal reference session.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

board_type

int

Calibration board type.

Returns: Add Result dict or None.

remove_calib_image(ip, pair_index)

Purpose: Removes the specified map pairs from the current marked session and applies to removing the mask, blur or error pattern samples.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

pair_index

int

Calibration image-pair index.

Returns: Delete Result dict or None.

calculate(ip)

Purpose: Use all the charts left in the current session to calculate internal and external references and return the complete configuration that you can write to the camera.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

Returns: Calculate results dict or None. == Mark Process

identify_board → Operators confirm step by step add_calib_image → Clear invalid image pair → Operator confirm. calculate → Operator confirm. set_intrinsic_parameters

The board should cover the location, distance and attitude of the field of view. detectSuccess, pairIndex, plate position, tilt and preview information; the image of the failed test must be used immediately pairIndex Call remove_calib_image(), the test is successful but the preview is not satisfactory. The image should also be deleted and re-recorded.

The operator can continue to collect or call the valid graphs retained after reaching the set number calculate(). After confirming that the error is normal, pass CameraParametersConfig.from_dict() Will cameraParametersConfig Convert to a strong type object; only if the operator has confirmed it definitively set_intrinsic_parameters().shouldWarnRms=true, complete configuration is missing, exit or end of input.

Multi-Image Source Type

All units pass once. calculate() Return full cameraParametersConfig.BinoWithColor Configuration of the aircraft type contains depth_src1, depth_src2 and texture_src; cameraParameters, colorCameraParameters and corresponding error fields to check the calculation details. Use when writing a camera cameraParametersConfig.

Interactive Example

python examples/intrinsic_calibration.py 10.10.11.33 4

The second parameter is the minimum valid graph logarithm required to allow the calculation, with the minimum value being 4; third parameter optional to specify known board_type. The console is used C Collection, collection`K` Retention or calculation,R Delete Replay,W Final confirmation for writing,B Back to collect,Q Safe exit. The image of the failed test will be automatically deleted; the process will be aborted when the failure is deleted, avoiding the use of data sets containing invalid samples.

Example: Write after confirmation

result = epiceye.calculate(ip)
if result is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Inline calculation failed")

print("Depth Double-eye RMS:", result["stereoRms"])
if result["colorStereoRms"] is not None:
    print("Main Depth Camera-Colour Camera RMS:", result["colorStereoRms"])
if result["shouldWarnRms"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Mark RMS Beyond security threshold, not written to camera")
camera_parameters_config = epiceye.CameraParametersConfig.from_dict(result["cameraParametersConfig"])
if input("Confirm to write the full configuration above to the camera? W Write, other inputs cancel:").strip().upper() != "W":
    print("Canceled, not written on camera")
    raise SystemExit(0)
if not epiceye.set_intrinsic_parameters(ip, camera_parameters_config):
    raise RuntimeError("Full reference configuration writing failed")

Example: Inline precision check

result = epiceye.check_intrinsic_accuracy(ip)
if result is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Inline precision check failed")

print("Board:", result["boardTypeDetected"])
print("Average/Max. Error:", result["stereoAveragePixelError"], result["stereoMaxPixelError"])
print("Mark tablet position:", result.get("boardPose"))
